description: Shared color configuration for MySurfLife. Three top-level keys: `ramps` (theme-neutral data-driven ramps baked into PNG tiles and read by frontend legends), `theme_accents` (per-theme chrome colors for the three Claude Design themes, consumed at runtime by particle shaders and markers), and `brand` (universal brand tokens from the D1 logo — paper/ink — shared across all themes). See notes/DESIGN_V2_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md §3.5 for the logo spec and full schema.

wind_speed.description: Theme-neutral wind speed ramp on the industry-standard Windy/wavemaps wind scale (blue-purple calm, green trades, amber fresh, red-violet gale, violet storm, white hurricane). Values converted from Windy's public m/s table to knots. Baked into /api/tiles/wind/... PNGs server-side. Frontend legends read these exact stops; only labeled stops render legend marks.

wind_gust.description: Wind gust ramp — identical scale to wind_speed (Windy renders its gust layer on the same color table, so a 30 kt gust looks like 30 kt wind). Baked into /api/tiles/wind/...?var=gust PNGs server-side.

wave_height.description: Theme-neutral wave height (significant wave height, Hs) ramp. Semantic labels tuned to surf vocabulary (small/fun/head-high/big/XL/XXL). Baked into /api/tiles/waves/... PNGs.

wave_period.description: Theme-neutral wave period (dominant period, Tp) ramp. Short periods are windswell, long periods are groundswell — semantic coloring helps users spot quality swells at a glance. Optional overlay (ships as a togglable layer in Phase 2).

ocean.description: Default dark theme (Dark Ocean). Matches the D1 logo brand palette exactly: aqua (swell origin dot) as accent, sunset orange (radiating half-rings) as fire. Used for particle colors, marker rings, rating dots, tide arrows, logo dot+rings in the header, storm tracker iconography.

dawn.description: Dawn Patrol theme. Warm coral/sunrise palette for early-morning surf sessions. Fire token is nearly identical to accent to reinforce the warm-sky feeling.

daylight.description: Bright satellite-style theme. High-contrast deep blue accent for visibility on light backgrounds. Used when ambient light is high (daytime mobile use, outdoor viewing). Logo uses `#0a8a9e` (aqua-on-light AA-safe) for the dot to maintain ≥ 4.5:1 contrast against the paper background.

logo_dot_aa.description: AA-safe aqua for the D1 origin dot when rendered on the paper/light background. Only used in the Daylight theme and in `paper` mark variant.

brand.description: Universal brand tokens from the D1 logo export pack. Theme-neutral — these values are the same in Ocean, Dawn, and Daylight. Used for the wordmark, tagline, apparel, favicons, and paper/ink surface colors that should never shift with theme.

paper.role: Background for light surfaces, apparel tees, paper-variant favicon, 'Paper' mark cell in export pack.

ink.role: Foreground for light surfaces, apparel text on paper tee, 'Ink' mark on paper, app icon rounded-rect background.

editorial.role: Session notes, dashboard hero headline, editorial pull-quotes.

mark_d1.description: The D1 logo mark: three nested half-rings (orange swell, radiating upward) above an aqua origin dot. 64×64 viewBox. All ring coordinates are relative to the dot at (32, 40). Half-rings sweep from -radius to +radius along the x-axis.
mark_d1.clear_space_rule: Equal to dot_radius (4px at native size — scales proportionally).

pulse_animation.description: Branded loading animation (`<LogoPulse>` component). The pulse-rings animation is the universal loading indicator across the entire app — all spinners, skeletons, and 'Loading…' placeholders migrate to this. Size recipes drop outer rings and accelerate pulse timing at smaller sizes to keep apparent angular velocity constant. See notes/DESIGN_V2_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md §3.5.9 for the migration checklist and usage policy.

96.description: Full-page splash, MapLoadingOverlay, route gate. Label rendered in Instrument Serif italic beneath.

48.description: Panel / card loading — PanelSkeleton hero, dashboard tile, AI analysis loading.

24.description: Inline — chart cell, list row, table cell, timeline slider knob. Compact (drops outer ring).

12.description: Button inline, AI 'thinking' indicator (replaces legacy .ai-pulse), eyebrow tag. Compact (drops outer two rings — inner only).

backend.usage: Loaded once at process start. Builds a 256-entry LUT per ramp from `domain` + `stops` + `interpolation`. `_interpolate_ramp(ramp, value)` returns 8-bit RGBA tuples for PNG encoding. `theme_accents` consumed by server-side rendering paths (OG images, cron'd artifacts) where DOM CSS is unavailable.

frontend.usage: Imported at build time via symlink from backend/config/ramps.json → frontend/src/config/ramps.json. Exposes rampStops(name), rampDomain(name), sampleRamp(name, value). Consumed by WaveHeightLegend.js, WindSpeedLegend.js, and click-to-probe color badges. `theme_accents` are NOT read from this file at runtime — runtime theme switching reads CSS custom properties (--accent, --fire) on document.documentElement. The JSON copy is for server-side rendering parity only.

forbidden_literals.message: Hex color literals forbidden in overlay layer and legend files. Import from frontend/src/design/ramps.js instead.
